    • Player

      public Player(int xPosition, int yPosition, int size, int hp, int damage)
      Constructs a player with the specified initial position, size, health points, and bullet damage.

      xPosition - The initial x-coordinate of the player.
      yPosition - The initial y-coordinate of the player.
      size - The size of the player.
      hp - The initial health points of the player.
